summary: Unidentified 33-year-old Durango man went missing while dirt biking in La Plata County on May 10, 2021; ~30 searchers, helicopters, a Colorado multi-mission aircraft, and canine units joined the search; a rescue canine found a body in Hermosa Creek near Jones Creek several days later; the body had not yet been recovered at publication due to ~600-ft steep terrain; coroner autopsy pending.
location: Hermosa Creek near Jones Creek, north of Durango
responding_agency: La Plata County Search and Rescue; Colorado multi-mission aircraft
notes: Identity withheld pending autopsy and next-of-kin notification at publication. LPCSAR president believed the man abandoned his motorcycle in Jones Creek and followed the creek on foot.
